CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Wednesday, February 24, 2021

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:31 p.m. He stated that all comments should be sent to
  planning@cityoflaverne.org.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chairperson Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jason Lorge,
  Phil May and Jason Simison. Not present: Jeff Allred (due to a conflict of
  interest). Advisory personnel present: Community Development Director Eric
  Scherer, City Attorney Bob Kress, Principal Planner Candice Bowcock and
  Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present: Matt Waken, Art Alvarado, Bryan
  Crawford, John Moreland, Peter Duarte, Larry Kosmont, Jim Kawamura, and
  Christine Donohue.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6.  CASE NOS. 20-20ZC, 109-20SP, 19-20GPA, AND 18-20TTM – A
  PROPOSAL TO DEVELOP 42 SINGLE FAMILY HOMES AT 2820
  AMHERST STREET (8666-021-902) AND A PORTION OF THE
  ADJACENT PARCEL, 8666-021-904, BOTH CITY-OWNED
  PROPERTIES. THE PROPERTIES ARE CURRENTLY ZONED PR3D
  AND ARE DESIGNATED LOW DENSITY RESDIENTIAL IN THE
  GENERAL PLAN.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1270
 Planning Commission Minutes
February 24, 2021
  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  RECCOMMENDING APPROVAL TO THE CITY COUNCIL FOR CASE
  NO. 18-20TTM, VESTING TENTATIVE TRACT MAP 83064, 109-20SP,
  ADOPTION OF THE “AMHERST COLLECTION SPECIFIC PLAN”, 20-
  20ZC, A ZONE CHANGE FROM PR3D TO SPECIFIC PLAN, AND 19-
  20GPA, A GENERAL PLAN AMMENDMENT CHANGING THE SITE
  FROM LOW DENSITY RESIDENTIAL TO MEDIUM DENSITY
  RESIDENTIAL. REQUESTS BY MJW INVESTMENTS, LLC, FOR A 5.6
  ACRE PARCEL LOCATED AT 2820 AMHERST STREET (8666-021-902)
  AND A PORTION OF THE ADJACENT PARCEL, 8666-021-904
  CREATING A 42 SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT
  AND ADOPTING THE PREPARED ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT
  REPORT FOR THE PROJECT.

  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock presented her report. Ms. Bowcock
  introduced Matt Waken of MJW Investments.

  Chairperson Simison opened the Public Hearing.

  A presentation was provided by Mr. Waken and Larry Kosmont.

  There were 28 public comments and 1 petition received. The following
  individuals were called:

  Sue Geddes
  Danita Beauchamp
  Jeff Allred
  Matt Uybocob
  Denise Fisher
  Cynthia Galbadon

  Chairperson Simison closed the Public Hearing.

  The Commissioners asked questions regarding the density and traffic concerns. It
  was suggested that a public workshop be held.

  Ms. Bowcock stated that a workshop can be added into the conditions but
  questioned whether it was allowed under the current health order.

  Mr. Scherer stated that due to the current orders gatherings are not allowed and a
  workshop would need to be held virtually via Zoom.

  Chairperson Simison re-opened the Public Hearing.

  The following individuals were called:

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
February 24, 2021

  Cynthia Galbadon
  Danita Beauchamp

  Chairperson closed the Public Hearing.

  The Commissioners further discussed the timing of a public workshop.

  Commissioner Lorge asked what is entailed for a new traffic study.

  Mr. Crawford stated that the growth rate was applied to the 2011 study and traffic
  cameras were used to determine an accurate traffic count.

  Chairperson Simison stated that the community needs to be heard. Commissioners
  Allison and Simison suggested the Commission condition a meeting.

  It was motioned by Commissioner May and seconded by Commissioner Allison
  to recommend approval with an added condition requiring a public workshop
  prior to the City Council meeting. Motion ended in a 2-2 vote (Commissioners
  Lorge and Simison opposed).

  The Commissioners continued their discussion on the matter.

  It was motioned by Commissioner May and seconded by Commissioner Allison
  that the Commission was unable to come to a consensus. Motion ended in a 2-2
  vote (Commissioner Lorge and Simison opposed).

  It was motioned by Chairperson Simison and seconded by Commissioner Lorge
  to continue the Public Hearing to a future date and condition a public workshop.
  Motion carried by a 3-1 vote (Commissioner Allison opposed).

OTHER MATTERS/INFORMATION

  None

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:08 p.m. The Planning Commission will meet at
  an adjourned meeting, date to be determined. The next regular meeting will be
  held March 10, 2021 at 6:30 p.m.

  Chairperson, Planning Commission
